evidence.detail: No data-href or class=clickable on rows; columns are 'Subject' and 'Creator', not 'Person', so prepare doesn't auto-generate person_url
initLinks attaches click → navigate without checking whether the click target is a form element (select/input/button); form elements and row navigation both fire
Existing-aliases table rows have no data-href or class=clickable; no person URL is exposed
No commits to these files since the issue was filed — all three sub-items remain open

triage.fix_sketch: Three sub-tasks: (1) In decksite/data/person.py load_notes(), alias subject_id→person_id and subject→person so prepare generates person_url; add data-href={{person_url}} class=clickable to tr in playernotes.mustache. (2) In shared_web/static/js/pd.js:initLinks add an early return when e.target.closest('a,button,input,select,textarea') to let form elements win. (3) In decksite/views/edit_aliases.py expose person URL on each alias entry; add data-href and clickable to the alias list rows in editaliases.mustache.
triage.notes: Three logically independent sub-tasks; each is small (~10–15 lines). The JS fix (sub-task 2) benefits all clickable-row pages, not just admin ones.
